# yousee

`bin/yousee` in this skill's directory is a CLI for the user's own Mit YouSee
account; below, `yousee` means that path. Every command prints exactly one JSON
document on stdout; progress goes to stderr.

## Commands

<!-- GENERATED from `yousee help` at build time — do not edit by hand -->
| Command | Returns |
|---|---|
| `yousee subscription show [--all]` | Active products with monthly price in DKK and the total |
| `yousee help` | This table plus exit codes, as JSON |

Run the command the user's question needs. There is no setup step; recover only on failure.

## When it fails

A failure is `{"error": {"kind", "message", "next", ...}}` with a fixed exit code.
Do what `next` says. In short:

| Exit | kind | Do |
|---|---|---|
| — | `bin/yousee` missing | Run `bash <this skill dir>/install.sh` once, then retry |
| 2 | input | Fix the flags (see `yousee help`) |
| 3 | drift | YouSee changed. Run `yousee report --last`, give the user the issue link, **stop** |
| 4 | session | Run `yousee login`; the user signs in in the Chrome window; rerun |
| 5 | network | Tell the user YouSee isn't responding; stop |

On drift, never work around the break with `curl`, raw GraphQL or the browser:
the answer would be built on a response the CLI no longer understands.

## When NOT to use

- Changing anything on the account (orders, add-ons, cancellations). The CLI is read-only.
- Anyone else's YouSee account.
